description: This file defines the main application component for a React-based dashboard app, including routing logic based on application state and rendering of different pages such as Dashboard, Habits, Tasks, and Settings. It also includes provider setup for global state management.

methods.name: RouterView
methods.description: Functional component that renders the current page based on application state and syncs routing with browser history.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main application component that wraps the RouterView with global state provider.
